items.html:
Two concrete defects:

  1. Plane-port illumination fails for framework T-matrices. _framework_tmatrix.py:120 omits PortWave from accepted physical incident types.

    import torch
import treams_rs as tr

incident = tr.Wave(
    [1, 0], basis=tr.PlaneWavePorts.default([0, 0]),
    k0=1.2, kind="up",
)
response = tr.sphere_tmatrix(
    k0=1.2, lmax=1, material=3,
    radius=torch.tensor(0.2, dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True),
)
response.interaction.illuminate(incident)

    Raises TypeError: must be real number, not PortWave; the same call with ordinary radius 0.2 succeeds. Include PortWave in that check or consistently use _regular_incident, which already handles it.

  2. Complex directions are rejected eagerly but silently changed under JAX JIT. _framework_waves.py:355-367 converts dynamic directions before enforcing the real-direction requirement.

    import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import treams_rs as tr

jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
direction = jnp.array([1 + 1j, 0, 1])
f = lambda d: tr.plane_wave(d, [1, 0], k0=1.2).direction

f(direction)           # ValueError: requires a real direction
jax.jit(f)(direction)  # [0.70710678, 0, 0.70710678]

    JIT discards the imaginary component before checking. PyTorch likewise rejects a constant complex direction but accepts it with requires_grad=True. Validate preserved input values before conversion.

Also, docs/differentiation/frameworks.md:361-366 incorrectly states that several newly implemented methods remain unavailable: rotation, metrics, sphere-to-cylinder conversion and reusable factors.

Read-only review covered the requested physical classes, their dispatch changes and related tests. Reproductions used the existing environment; no edits, installations, builds or full-suite runs.

Fixed both defects in canonical:

  • Interaction illumination accepts plane-port waves.
  • Traced directions retain imaginary components until validation; nonreal directions raise consistently. Complex arrays with zero imaginary components retain correct gradients.

Added four-backend regressions covering values, finite-difference gradients and invalid directions. Updated the adapter wording.

Verified 160 tests passed in the latest canonical environment; Ruff lint and formatting passed. Files are ready for integration. No Git mutations or builds.
